summary: Frontend-only regression + new feature test for the Vaginal Cytology (More Than 100 Cells) 'flex' calculator. All six requested sections (A–F) passed end-to-end via mobile Playwright automation at 375x812. Type screen shows the 4 cards in the correct order with correct testIDs; the 100-cell regression still returns 'Late Proestrus' (CI 75%) with no TOTAL pill and percentage-only cell rows; the new /evaluation/cytology-flex screen shows title 'Cytology (> 100 Cells)', subtitle 'Enter raw counts — % auto-calculated', computes correct per-row percentages, CI and total, feeds them into classifyCytology so stages match the 100-cell logic (150 cells → Mid Proestrus, 200 cells → Estrus), Result screen shows the 'TOTAL n CELLS' pill and 'X cells   Y.Y%' per row, History lists 'CYTOLOGY · 150 CELLS' / 'CYTOLOGY · 200 CELLS', and PDF export does not crash the app.
critical_code_review_comments: cytology-flex.tsx: `nums[c.key]` inside donutData is fine but consider a Map for readability (non-blocking).

result.tsx generateHTML — the header row `Total counted…` sits BEFORE the individual rows; visually acceptable but slightly unusual ordering (Total shown above the breakdown). Consider moving after the rows for clarity — cosmetic only.
Pre-existing React-Native-Web console noise (`transform-origin` invalid DOM prop, `useNativeDriver` warning, `props.pointerEvents` deprecation) — unrelated to this change but still logged.
seed_data_creation: Two flex dogs 'Bella-Flex1' (150 cells) and 'Bella-Flex2' (200 cells) plus one 100-cell dog 'Bella-100' were created in localStorage as part of the automation. They now appear in History.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash → onboarding (fill name+mobile at minimum) → dashboard-new-evaluation → dog form → new-eval-continue-button → method-cytology_flex → cytoflex-{pc,ic,sic,sc,cc}-input → cytoflex-calculate-button → /evaluation/result. Result page shows 'TOTAL n CELLS' pill only when inputs._mode==='flex'. History label switches to 'CYTOLOGY · n CELLS' via the same _mode flag.
rca_of_issue: n/a — feature verification only. No bugs found. Every deterministic assertion passed: card order, cytology 100-cell regression (Late Proestrus, CI 75%, no total pill, % rows), flex 150 (title/subtitle/per-row %/CI 50%/stage=Mid Proestrus/TOTAL 150 CELLS pill/'15 cells 10.0%' etc.), flex 200 (CI 80%/stage=Estrus/TOTAL 200 CELLS), history subtitles, and PDF button non-crash.
